newsitem.title: USA: Colombia global bond issue gets upped to $1.0 bln. [CORRECTED 15:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Colombia global bond issue gets upped to $1.0 bln. [CORRECTED 15:35 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects spelling of "Colombia" in headline and text)

The Republic of Colombia's global bond issue was boosted in size to $1.0 billion with the addition of a second tranche to meet growing investor demand for the issue, syndicate sources said on Wednesday.
The initial deal consisted of $750 million in 10-year global bonds but a $250 million 30-year tranche has since been added to the offering, syndicate sources said.
Price talk on the 10-year issue is seen between 130-135 basis points over U.S. Treasuries while price talk on the 30-year is expected in the area of 170 to 175 basis points, sources added.
The deal, which is expected to be launched later Wednesday, will be underwritten by joint managers Merrill Lynch & Co and JP Morgan Securities.
